note: Look library. 'prompt' is injected into every render prompt; 'avoid' goes to the model's negative prompt when it has one, otherwise into the prompt. Descriptions are user-facing. Studio and artist names are deliberately not used. 'family' is photoreal, 3d, 2d, hybrid, craft, art, genre or auto; 'genre' looks are layered on top of another look.

styles.name: Auto: match my references
styles.description: Follow the look of your character and set sheets exactly.
styles.prompt: Match the visual style of the reference images exactly: the same rendering technique, character design, proportions, colours and level of detail.
styles.avoid: a different art style from the references

styles.name: Photorealistic CGI
styles.description: Digital characters and environments designed to resemble live-action footage.
styles.prompt: Photorealistic CGI: physically accurate materials, realistic skin pores and hair, natural lighting and lens behaviour, indistinguishable from live-action cinematography.
styles.avoid: cartoon proportions, cel shading, illustrated look, plastic skin

styles.name: Cinematic live action
styles.description: Looks filmed with real actors and a cinema camera.
styles.prompt: Cinematic live-action footage: real actors and locations, shot on a cinema camera with anamorphic lenses, natural skin texture, filmic colour grade and grain.
styles.avoid: animation, cartoon, CGI look, illustration

styles.name: Hyperrealism
styles.description: Extreme surface detail: every pore, thread and reflection, almost microscopic.
styles.prompt: Hyperrealistic cinematic imagery: extreme surface detail, visible skin pores and fine hair, precise fabric weave, accurate reflections and micro-texture, razor-sharp focus, true-to-life proportions, physically accurate light.
styles.avoid: illustration, cartoon, soft focus, plastic skin, stylised proportions

styles.name: Documentary realism
styles.description: Unpolished, observational, natural light; it feels lived in and true.
styles.prompt: Documentary realism: handheld observational camera, available natural light, unretouched skin, lived-in real locations, muted honest colour, slightly imperfect framing, candid moments that were not staged for the camera.
styles.avoid: glossy lighting, studio polish, fantasy colour grade, animation, stylised

styles.name: Stylised photorealism
styles.description: Real forms and materials pushed by bold colour grading and expressive light.
styles.prompt: Stylised photorealism: real people, materials and places, heightened by a strong colour grade, dramatic expressive lighting and graphic composition; believable, but clearly art-directed.
styles.avoid: flat lighting, cartoon proportions, illustration, washed-out neutral grade

styles.name: Editorial fashion photography
styles.description: Polished, controlled light, elegant poses, luxury-magazine composition.
styles.prompt: High-end editorial fashion photography look: precisely controlled studio and natural light, elegant posing, couture styling, clean luxurious composition, flawless but real skin, shallow depth of field.
styles.avoid: snapshot look, cluttered background, harsh amateur flash, cartoon, illustration

styles.name: Fine-art photography
styles.description: Mood, symbolism and artistic composition in photographic form.
styles.prompt: Fine-art photography: contemplative composition, symbolic objects and gestures, restrained tonal palette, soft directional light, deliberate negative space, a quiet painterly mood captured with a real camera.
styles.avoid: busy commercial look, cartoon, illustration, oversaturated colour

styles.name: Analog film realism
styles.description: Film grain, halation and the warm, imperfect colour of real film stock.
styles.prompt: Analog film realism: visible organic grain, soft halation around bright lights, gentle gate weave, faded blacks, warm vintage colour reproduction of real photochemical film, vintage lenses with slight softness at the edges.
styles.avoid: clean digital sharpness, plastic skin, animation, HDR look

styles.name: Film noir
styles.description: Deep shadows, dramatic highlights, rain-slick streets and mystery.
styles.prompt: Film noir: high-contrast black-and-white cinematography, hard single-source key light, venetian-blind shadows, deep blacks, cigarette smoke and wet streets, low angles, moody off-centre composition.
styles.avoid: bright flat lighting, saturated colour, cartoon, cheerful mood

styles.name: HDR realism
styles.description: Rich detail kept in both deep shadows and bright highlights.
styles.prompt: HDR realism: wide dynamic range with detail preserved in both shadows and highlights, rich local contrast, vivid but natural colour, crisp textures, luminous skies and clean deep blacks.
styles.avoid: blown highlights, crushed blacks, flat dull contrast, cartoon

styles.name: Feature animation 3D

styles.prompt: High-end 3D animated feature film style: appealing stylized characters with expressive faces and large eyes, soft subsurface-scattered skin, detailed hair and fabric, rich global illumination, cinematic depth of field, polished art-directed environments.
styles.avoid: photorealistic humans, live-action footage, flat 2D shading, low-poly models

styles.name: Stylized 3D

styles.prompt: Stylized 3D animation: deliberately simplified, exaggerated character shapes and proportions, bold graphic silhouettes, clean readable forms, painterly textures, strong art-directed colour.
styles.avoid: photorealism, realistic human proportions, live-action footage

styles.name: Cel-shaded 3D

styles.prompt: Cel-shaded 3D animation: 3D characters and sets rendered with flat toon shading, crisp ink outlines, limited shadow tones and a hand-drawn comic finish.

styles.name: Pixilation
styles.description: Real people photographed frame by frame for strange, staccato motion.
styles.prompt: Pixilation: real human actors photographed frame by frame, gliding without walking, jerky staccato poses, sudden jumps and impossible slides, plain everyday locations lit practically.
styles.avoid: smooth natural motion, animation drawing, CGI

styles.name: Object animation
styles.description: Everyday objects brought to life through tiny repositioning.
styles.prompt: Object animation: everyday household objects brought to life frame by frame, macro lenses and practical desk lighting, scratches, dust and fingerprints, tiny stepped shifts that give each object a personality.
styles.avoid: smooth CGI, cartoon drawing, photorealistic humans

styles.name: Pixel art
styles.description: Retro video-game pixels with limited palettes.
styles.prompt: Pixel-art animation: low-resolution sprite characters and tiled backgrounds, crisp square pixels, limited retro colour palette, stepped sprite animation.
styles.avoid: smooth gradients, anti-aliased lines, 3D render, photorealism
styles.figures: people are drawn as pixel art: visible square pixels, a limited colour palette, faces as a few pixels, hair and clothes as flat pixel blocks, no smooth gradients
styles.figures_avoid: smooth gradients, anti-aliased soft edges, photoreal detail, high-resolution skin

styles.name: Motion graphics
styles.fit: Best for lyric or graphic videos
styles.description: Animated typography, icons, shapes and graphic layouts driven by the music.
styles.prompt: Motion-graphics style: bold flat shapes, icons and graphic layouts animated in rhythm, clean vector design, strong colour blocking.
styles.avoid: photorealism, detailed character animation

styles.name: Whiteboard animation
styles.fit: Best for lyric or explainer videos
styles.description: Drawings appear as they're being made; common in educational videos.
styles.prompt: Whiteboard animation: black marker line drawings appearing stroke by stroke on a clean white board, occasional single accent colour.
styles.avoid: full colour rendering, 3D, photorealism

styles.name: Surrealist animation
styles.description: Dream logic, impossible transformations and symbolic images.
styles.prompt: Surrealist animation: dream logic and impossible juxtapositions, objects that melt and transform, floating symbolic figures, vast empty horizons, hyper-clear light that feels like a lucid dream.
styles.avoid: plain literal realism, mundane everyday scenes

styles.name: Abstract expressionist animation
styles.description: Moving expressive paint, shape and colour.
styles.prompt: Abstract expressionist animation: sweeping gestural paint, thrown colour and violent brush energy that evolves and collides, shapes that suggest figures without depicting them.
styles.avoid: literal figurative detail, photorealism, clean geometry

styles.name: Minimalist animation
styles.description: Simple forms, restricted palettes and deliberate movement.
styles.prompt: Minimalist animation: a few simple shapes on a near-empty ground, a restricted two-to-three colour palette, generous negative space and slow deliberate movement.
styles.avoid: busy detail, textures, photorealism, clutter

styles.name: Glitch art
styles.description: Digital distortion, corrupted pixels and signal interference.
styles.prompt: Glitch art: RGB channel splitting, corrupted pixel blocks, scanline tearing, data-moshed smears and signal interference breaking up the image, cold digital colour.
styles.avoid: clean undamaged image, natural film look, painterly

styles.name: Vaporwave
styles.description: Pastel neon, retro computers and classical sculpture.
styles.prompt: Vaporwave: pastel pink and cyan neon, marble classical busts, retro computer windows, palm trees and sunset grids, nostalgic early-digital haze and glossy 90s chrome.
styles.avoid: natural muted palette, gritty realism, rustic textures

styles.name: Neon cyberpunk
styles.description: Glowing saturated colour, rainy cities and high-contrast futures.
styles.prompt: Neon cyberpunk: rain-slick night streets lit by saturated magenta and cyan neon, holographic signs, dense vertical city, high contrast, lens flares and steam.
styles.avoid: daylight, natural muted palette, rustic setting

styles.name: Retro futurism
styles.description: Mid-century visions of the future.
styles.prompt: Retro futurism: mid-century optimism, atomic-age curves and chrome, pastel and primary colour, streamlined rockets and domed cities as imagined in the 1950s, printed poster texture.
styles.avoid: gritty dystopia, modern minimal design, photorealism

styles.name: Holographic sci-fi
styles.description: Translucent light interfaces and volumetric imagery.
styles.prompt: Holographic sci-fi: translucent glowing light-built interfaces and figures, volumetric beams, thin grid and scan-line patterns, cool blue and cyan emission against dark space.
styles.avoid: solid matte materials, warm rustic light, painterly

styles.name: Art Nouveau
styles.description: Flowing botanical lines and elegant ornament.
styles.prompt: Art Nouveau: flowing whiplash botanical lines, ornamental floral frames, elongated elegant figures, muted gold-green-rose palette and decorative poster composition.
styles.avoid: harsh geometry, photorealism, minimal bare design

styles.name: Art Deco
styles.description: Symmetry, luxury, metallic accents and grand geometry.
styles.prompt: Art Deco: strict symmetry, stepped geometric ornament, gold and black with jewel accents, polished metal and marble, sweeping grand architecture and glamour lighting.
styles.avoid: organic clutter, rustic roughness, minimal modern

styles.name: Ukiyo-e woodblock
styles.description: Japanese woodblock aesthetics: flat colour, bold contours.
styles.prompt: Ukiyo-e woodblock print: flat areas of colour with bold black contour lines, patterned kimono and waves, subtle paper grain, asymmetrical compositions and soft gradient skies.
styles.avoid: photorealism, 3D rendering, soft airbrushed shading

styles.name: Renaissance painting
styles.description: Classical realism, perspective and sculptural light.
styles.prompt: Renaissance painting: balanced harmonious composition, linear perspective, sculptural soft chiaroscuro, earthy rich pigments, calm idealised figures and atmospheric landscape depth.
styles.avoid: modern clothing, neon colour, flat cartoon shapes

styles.name: Baroque painting
styles.description: Dramatic chiaroscuro and emotionally charged movement.
styles.prompt: Baroque painting: dramatic chiaroscuro with a single shaft of light in deep darkness, swirling diagonal movement, rich velvet reds and golds, heightened emotion and theatrical gesture.
styles.avoid: flat even lighting, minimalism, cartoon shapes

styles.name: Romanticism
styles.description: Sublime landscapes and emotional intensity.
styles.prompt: Romanticism: sublime sweeping landscapes under stormy skies, tiny figures facing vast nature, luminous mist, intense emotional atmosphere and dramatic painterly light.
styles.avoid: urban modern setting, flat graphic shapes, photographic sharpness

styles.name: Impressionism
styles.description: Visible brushwork, shifting light and atmospheric colour.
styles.prompt: Impressionism: broken dabs of colour, visible quick brushwork, shimmering light on water and leaves, soft undefined edges and colourful shadows capturing a fleeting moment.
styles.avoid: sharp detail, hard outlines, photographic precision

styles.name: Expressionism
styles.description: Distorted shapes and colour that carry raw emotion.
styles.prompt: Expressionism: deliberately distorted angular forms, bold jarring colour, tilted architecture and exaggerated faces that externalise inner emotion, thick agitated brushwork.
styles.avoid: naturalistic calm proportion, photographic realism

styles.name: Cubism
styles.description: Fragmented forms and multiple simultaneous viewpoints.
styles.prompt: Cubism: figures and objects broken into overlapping geometric planes seen from several angles at once, muted earthy palette and collage-like angular fragments.
styles.avoid: single-viewpoint realism, soft smooth blending, photographic

styles.name: Pop art
styles.description: Bold commercial colour and mass-media imagery.
styles.prompt: Pop art: flat saturated primary colours, thick black outlines, Ben-Day halftone dots, repeated mass-media imagery, high graphic contrast and glossy advertising energy.
styles.avoid: muted subtle palette, photographic depth, painterly softness

styles.name: Bauhaus
styles.description: Functional geometry, primary colour and structured composition.
styles.prompt: Bauhaus design: circles, squares and triangles in red, yellow, blue and black, strict grid composition, sans-serif typography and functional geometric simplicity.
styles.avoid: ornamental clutter, organic textures, photorealism

styles.name: African folk-art-inspired
styles.description: Visuals drawing on specific African artistic traditions.
styles.prompt: African folk-art-inspired animation: bold patterned textiles, carved wood and woven textures, strong graphic shapes and earth-and-indigo palettes drawn from the specific regional tradition the film names, never a generic 'tribal' look.
styles.avoid: generic stereotyped imagery, pseudo-tribal clichés, photorealism

styles.name: Mosaic animation
styles.description: Imagery assembled from coloured tiles, stone or glass.
styles.prompt: Mosaic animation: everything built from small coloured tesserae of stone and glass with visible grout lines, glittering gold tiles and shifting patterns of tiny pieces.
styles.avoid: smooth continuous gradients, photorealism
styles.figures: people are made of mosaic tiles: small visible tesserae with grout lines, flat tile colours
styles.figures_avoid: smooth skin, hair strands, soft shading

styles.name: Stained-glass animation
styles.description: Luminous jewel-toned imagery inside dark dividing lines.
styles.prompt: Stained-glass animation: jewel-toned translucent panes divided by thick dark leading lines, backlit glow with light spilling across surfaces, flat segmented shapes and sacred luminous colour.
styles.avoid: opaque matte surfaces, soft gradients, photorealism
styles.figures: people are made of stained glass: coloured glass pieces separated by thick dark lead lines, flat translucent colours
styles.figures_avoid: smooth skin, hair strands, soft shading

styles.name: Illuminated manuscript
styles.description: Ornate lettering, decorative borders and miniature paintings.
styles.prompt: Illuminated manuscript: miniature paintings on parchment, burnished gold leaf, ornate borders of vines and beasts, flat medieval perspective and rich lapis, vermilion and green pigments.
styles.avoid: photographic depth, modern minimal design, 3D rendering

styles.name: Linocut illustration
styles.description: Bold carved marks and expressive printed texture.
styles.prompt: Linocut illustration: bold carved lines and solid blocks of ink in two or three flat colours, slightly misregistered print layers, rough paper texture and expressive graphic shapes.
styles.avoid: soft gradients, photorealism, thin delicate lines

styles.name: Chalk pastel animation
styles.description: Soft dusty colour and blended hand-drawn transitions.
styles.prompt: Chalk pastel animation: soft dusty blended pastel colour on toothy dark paper, visible chalk strokes and smudged fingerprints, glowing hand-drawn transitions between frames.
styles.avoid: hard vector edges, glossy surfaces, photorealism

styles.name: Epic fantasy
styles.description: Monumental landscapes, magical light and mythic scale.
styles.prompt: Epic fantasy feel: monumental landscapes and ancient citadels, magical shafts of light, ornate costume and armour, tiny figures against huge mythic scale and sweeping heroic atmosphere.
styles.avoid: modern everyday setting, mundane scale

styles.name: Dark fantasy
styles.description: Gothic architecture, strange creatures and an uneasy atmosphere.
styles.prompt: Dark fantasy feel: crumbling gothic architecture, fog and ash, strange half-seen creatures, desaturated cold palette with ember highlights and an uneasy ominous atmosphere.
styles.avoid: cheerful bright mood, clean modern setting

styles.name: Whimsical fantasy
styles.description: Charming exaggeration and playful magical details.
styles.prompt: Whimsical fantasy feel: crooked cosy houses, floating lanterns, tiny magical creatures, playful exaggerated scale, warm glowing colour and delight in every corner.
styles.avoid: grim gritty mood, cold desaturated palette

styles.name: Science-fiction realism
styles.description: Plausible technology and grounded futuristic worldbuilding.
styles.prompt: Science-fiction realism feel: plausible near-future technology, lived-in functional interfaces, realistic materials and wear, cool restrained light and grounded believable worldbuilding.
styles.avoid: magic, fantasy ornament, cartoon gadgets

styles.name: Space opera
styles.description: Monumental spacecraft, cosmic scenery and heroic spectacle.
styles.prompt: Space opera feel: colossal spacecraft and nebula skies, dramatic coloured starlight, vast alien horizons, heroic costume and sweeping cosmic spectacle.
styles.avoid: everyday earthbound setting, small intimate scale

styles.name: Steampunk
styles.description: Victorian engineering, brass machinery, gears and steam.
styles.prompt: Steampunk feel: polished brass and copper machinery, exposed gears and riveted iron, steam plumes, Victorian-style clothing and goggles, warm amber gaslight.
styles.avoid: sleek minimal technology, neon, modern clothing

styles.name: Dieselpunk
styles.description: Heavy industry, retro military design and interwar futurism.
styles.prompt: Dieselpunk feel: oil-stained heavy machinery, riveted steel and airships, interwar propaganda-poster styling, smoky sodium light and a grimy industrial palette.
styles.avoid: clean sleek technology, pastel colour

styles.name: Solarpunk
styles.description: Green cities, clean technology and optimistic futures.
styles.prompt: Solarpunk feel: sunlit cities overgrown with gardens and living walls, solar glass and wind turbines, airy white architecture, warm hopeful light and community life.
styles.avoid: grim dystopia, smog, ruins

styles.name: Post-apocalyptic
styles.description: Abandoned infrastructure and reclaimed nature.
styles.prompt: Post-apocalyptic feel: collapsed infrastructure reclaimed by plants, rusted vehicles, patched clothing and makeshift shelters, hazy dusty light and a weathered faded palette.
styles.avoid: clean new buildings, bright cheerful colour

styles.name: Gothic horror
styles.description: Deep shadows, eerie architecture and unsettling beauty.
styles.prompt: Gothic horror feel: candlelit crypts and long corridors, deep shadows with pale moonlight, cobwebs and carved stone, slow creeping dread and eerie beauty.
styles.avoid: bright flat daylight, cheerful mood

styles.name: Magical realism
styles.description: Believable everyday places with quiet impossible things.
styles.prompt: Magical realism feel: ordinary believable places in which quiet impossible things simply happen, treated as normal, warm natural light with a faint dreamlike glow and gentle poetic detail.
styles.avoid: overt fantasy spectacle, cartoon exaggeration

styles.name: Biblical epic
styles.description: Ancient settings, vast landscapes and reverent scale.
styles.prompt: Biblical epic feel: ancient desert and village settings, hand-woven linen and wool, oil lamps and golden-hour light, vast reverent landscapes and dignified unhurried staging.
styles.avoid: modern objects, irreverent comedy, sci-fi elements
